changes_made.explanation: Added missing NLG tasks (factoid QA), removed incorrect task (code generation), normalized capitalization, consolidated GPT-3 variants, clarified outputs to include both SPARQL and natural language generation aspects
Normalized metric names to standard forms (F1 instead of Macro F1), removed redundant entries
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. GPT-3 is used for generation, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were automatic using Exact Match and F1 metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on semantic parsing and question answering using LLMs, with automatic evaluation metrics. The main contribution is using LLMs for SPARQL query generation and combining them with direct GPT-3 answers for improved factuality. While generation occurs (both SPARQL queries and natural language answers), the primary focus is on the semantic parsing aspect rather than pure NLG evaluation.
